messages:
maya: Quick async standup — long-context onboarding + eval sanity checks

maya: What I did:
- landed longctx tokenization fix for 32k+ inputs (PR: #842)
- ran baseline eval on small promptset (1k cases)

maya: Blockers:
- eval harness fails intermittently on sequences > 50k (OOMs on dedupe stage)
- unclear whether truncation is in tokenizer or kv cache warmup

maya: Today:
- repro longseq OOM locally with `scripts/run_eval --max-len 65536`
- pair w/ @jonas on infra mem tracking

jonas: I can repro the OOM with the dedupe step — looks like a mem leak in the batch combiner. Will instrument with `nvprof` and add a lightweight mem reporter into runtime.

priya: Saw a quality regression on code completion prompts — model drops out part-way when prompt includes fenced ```python blocks. Added 6 failing cases to the promptset: https://redwood.internal/promptsets/longctx-code

alex: Quick ask — can we pin RNG for evals? Results bounce between runs. Add `--seed=42` to harness. Also suggest `--deterministic-io` flag for batching.

sam: deploy-bot ran the smoke job: `longctx-smoke-2026-03-16` — few warnings but passed token rates. Log: `WARN: token-alloc fallbacks x3` (link: https://ci.redwood/longctx/2026-03-16)

nora: I'll run the extended 64k synthetic battery tonight and upload outputs to the shared bucket. Expect ~8h run on a single A100. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

maya: Action items
- @jonas add mem reporter + nvprof traces (blocked -> debug)
- @priya add failing cases to gated evals + small repro
- @alex add deterministic flags to harness; push PR
- @nora run 64k battery and share artifacts
- I'll triage tokenizer vs kv cache with a minimal repro

maya: Ping if you're blocked, otherwise report results in this thread. :eyes:
